evals.prompt: I have a project that follows a strict in-house engineering doctrine, with a single source-of-truth infrastructure file and a custom compiler. There's already a `web` core service. I want to add a Redis cache as a backing service and have the `web` service learn how to reach it through its environment so the application can connect at startup. Show me exactly what to add to the infrastructure file — both the new cache service entry and whatever needs to change on the `web` service — so that this compiles cleanly under the doctrine's compiler. Keep it tight and tell me anything the compiler would reject if I got it wrong.
evals.expected_output: An infra.yml diff that (1) adds a `cache` backing service with `role: cache`, `engine: redis`, a `version`, and a `networks` list; (2) wires the cache's connection parts into web's `env:` block using the doctrine's magic-ref interpolation syntax `${backing_services.cache.host}` / `${backing_services.cache.port}` rather than a single composed connection string; and (3) adds `cache` to web's `depends_on`, because a magic ref between services that lacks a matching depends_on entry is a hard compile error.
expectations: DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): the cache's connection info is wired into web via the bespoke magic-ref interpolation syntax of the exact form ${backing_services.<service>.<part>} (e.g. ${backing_services.cache.host} and ${backing_services.cache.port}) placed inside web's `env:` block

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): wires DISCRETE PARTS (separate env vars for host and port) rather than a single pre-composed connection string / URL — the doctrine forbids a composed `url` part and requires the consumer to build any handle from parts at runtime; an answer that sets one REDIS_URL=redis://... magic ref is doctrine-wrong

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): adds `cache` to web's `depends_on` list and ties this to the rule that any magic ref implying a cross-service dependency MUST be matched by a corresponding depends_on entry or the compiler errors
CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): the new service is declared under `backing_services` with `role: cache` and `engine: redis`
CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): the cache service declares a `version` and a `networks` list (e.g. networks: [internal])
